method: FingerGAN (Zhu, Yin & Hu, TPAMI 2023), released weights, zero-shot (E03's network and windows), on MSU-normalised input, with its ridge map rendered as a normalised print
_normalization: input = fpr.data.normalization.normalize(degraded) (sigma 2.5, the evaluator's normalisation) instead of E03's sigma-6 texture of the raw print; output = the ridge map, Gaussian-blurred by render_sigma and normalize()d, measured as stored (evaluate.py --rec-normalized)
_weights: relative to experiments/baselines/E03_fingergan/ (E03's download, not copied)
_invert: polarity checked again on 40 v2 val prints: E03's raw ridge map correlates +0.53 with the normalised clean print (band-passed, local NCC), its inverse -0.53, so its bright lines lie on the valleys as in a normalised print; no inversion

sweep._note: tex6_s0 reproduces E03 under the v3 evaluator (sanity check); tex6 vs norm isolates the input change, s0 vs s1.5 the rendering (sigma 1.5 was the best of 1, 1.5, 2, 3 for E03's own maps on 40 v2 val prints: ridge fidelity in the mask 0.50 -> 0.58), _pb the paste-back. Selection: highest net rescue among gate passes, ties -> ridge fidelity (val_sweep.choose)
